title: A test that every refusal code the SQL returns has words in the function and screen that read it
why_needed: Business refusals travel as `{ok:false, code}` from SQL through the Edge Functions' REFUSALS maps and src/lib/admin-orders.ts REFUSALS to the screens; a code with no entry falls to a generic «تعذّر الحفظ. حاول مرة أخرى.» or «تعذّر تنفيذ الإجراء.». The in-progress fix migrations already added four such codes with no words (QUALITY-03), and nothing in CI notices. A unit test that extracts `'code', '<X>'` from the latest definition of each function (as scratch sql-codes.cjs does) and asserts each consumer map covers it would make the drift fail CI.
